posts.caption:
Round three is where fights get decided.
Not because of skill. Because of the tank.

1. Exhale on every shot. Holding your breath empties you faster.
2. Clinch, breathe, reset. Ten seconds of rest nobody sees.
3. Jab more, chase less. A busy jab buys time.
4. Tired is just a feeling. He's just as tired as you.
5. Hands up when they're heavy. Tired guards get finished.
6. Win the last 30 seconds. Judges remember the finish.

Save this before your next hard sparring day.
